name: Static Code Scan
description: Static analysis scan of entire codebase. Check for hardcoded mock data, missing auth middleware, cross-org queries without org_id filter, unused imports from SEC changes, console.error without user feedback, TODO/FIXME/HACK comments indicating unfinished work.
acceptanceCriteria: T-020.AC1: No hardcoded static arrays used as data source in page components (grep for mock patterns)
T-020.AC2: All API routes in server/routes/ have auth middleware
T-020.AC3: All DB queries that return user-visible data filter by org_id
T-020.AC4: No unused imports in files modified by SEC sprints
T-020.AC5: Count of TODO/FIXME/HACK comments documented with locations
T-020.AC6: No production credentials in committed code (grep for API keys, passwords)
T-020.AC7: All page components have data-testid attributes on key interactive elements
method: Static analysis agents — read-only scan, no code changes
